extraction.Name: Louise Bordeaux Jarboe
extraction.Refused/Protested: No protest was made because I did not know it would be subject to tax.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: The land was once sold for taxes but I did not know that there were taxes against the land until the man who bought the tax certificate wrote to me that he had bought it and asked whether I wished to redeem the land? I redeemed it.
extraction.NOTES: Two children depend upon her for support; children had been taken off the rolls at Rosebud after she got her patent but before she sold the land; patent was mailed to her while away from the reservation with a letter stating she should sign the receipt attached and return to the Rosebud agency; sold land in 1926 for $2300.00 cash; document notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, subscribed and sworn May 31, 1929.
